settings.heading: Multicolor Rugs, Made for Real Homes
settings.row_content:
Not every room needs more furniture. Sometimes it just needs color underfoot.

A multicolor rug has a way of changing how a space feels without you having to explain it. The room feels warmer. A little more lived-in. Like someone actually spends time there. That’s the idea behind this collection at Indian Rug Store.

These carpets are developed to not only meet the expectations of today's trends but are also created using traditional Indian technique, which relies on slow, manual labor as opposed to a computer generated design concept typical of today's design techniques.

You’ll notice it right away. The colors don’t shout. They sit together comfortably.

settings.heading: Colorful Area Rugs That Don’t Try Too Hard
settings.row_content:
Color can be tricky. Too much and it feels loud. Too little and the room feels flat.

Our colorful area rugs land somewhere in between. Colorful rugs are a great way to add personality and style to your living room while still allowing balance between all its elements: sofas, tables, art and light.

When completing your living room with a colorful area rug (as opposed to finding new furniture and accessories), you'll have a complete room much sooner than if you purchased new furniture. The rug helps to create an anchor for the room and allows the eye to go to one point or area.

Each area rug is handmade which means that there will be minor variations in both the weave and color of the rugs. Because of this, the rug will not feel or look mass-produced to you. This is done on purpose so that you truly feel like you have bought something special.

settings.heading: Multicolor Outdoor Rugs That Feel Surprisingly Cozy
settings.row_content:
Outdoor spaces tend to get overlooked. A couple of chairs, maybe a table, and that’s it.

A multicolor outdoor rug changes that.Our outdoor furniture collections create a connection between your exterior and interior spaces, making them seem like one continuous space rather than just an extra area. All of our pieces are fabricated with the same great quality materials as our indoor furniture so that you can enjoy them and have them last through years of use.

You'll be amazed at how comfortable you feel on your covered patio, balcony, or sunroom, regardless of the weather.

settings.heading: Easy Colors That Blend In (In a Good Way)
settings.row_content:
Even though these are multicolor rugs, many lean on familiar base tones, which makes styling easier than you’d expect.

You’ll find designs that feel close to a green-colored rug, especially if you like earthy, grounded spaces. Others pull from soft blues, similar to a blue color area rug, which works beautifully in relaxed or coastal-style homes. And some are anchored with gray tones, like a gray color area rug, keeping brighter accents calm and collected.

Nothing feels random. The colors work together because they’ve been used together for generations.

settings.heading: Why These Rugs Feel Different
settings.row_content:
There’s a certain weight and texture you only get with handcrafted rugs. You notice it when you walk across the room barefoot.

  • Handwoven by artisans in India
  • Made with natural materials like cotton and wool
  • Designed to suit modern American homes without losing their roots
  • No two rugs are exactly alike

These are rugs you don’t rush to replace. They settle into your space over time.

settings.heading: Choosing the Right Multicolor Rug
settings.row_content:
A rug is a personal thing. It affects how you feel in a room more than most people realize.

Whether you’re looking for something subtle or something a bit more expressive, our multicolor rug collection is meant to help your home feel finished - without feeling styled.

Take your time. Scroll through. You’ll know when one feels right.

settings.heading: What does multicolor rug mean?
settings.row_content: A multicolor rug is any type of area rug that utilizes multiple colors in one design. Instead of using one type of color to create a singular design, a multicolor design incorporates multiple types of color; each having their own level of intensity, to provide the user with an interesting visual element to the space. Numerous people are drawn to multicolor area rugs due to the wide variety they have and the ease they provide for decorating a space with existing furniture and/or decor.

settings.heading: Is multicolor rug suitable for living room(s)?
settings.row_content: Absolutely! They've been found to be one of the best area rugs for the living room(s). Colorful rugs in living rooms can tie together an assortment of furnishings; couches, chairs, artwork, accent pieces, etc. that may not all match the same design and create uniformity through balance while maintaining the overall theme (casual or formal) without having the space appear overly decorated.

settings.heading: What is the best way to style my colorful rug(s) in my living room(s)?
settings.row_content: The simplest way to achieve a stylish colorful rug in your living room is to accent a couple of the colourful's colour(s) by accenting them with other items; pillows, decorative throws, wall art. The remainder of your living room's decor should be fairly neutral in order to allow your colorful rug to visually dominate the room while the other decorative items visually complement your colourful rug.
